title: The Walking Dead: Streets of Survival
summary: The Walking Dead: Streets of Survival is a Trailmark Games release that came out on Switch 2 on September 18, 2026, at $19.99. At 2.2 GB it is one of the smallest games on the system, so storage will never be the problem. The catch is the physical edition: even for such a small game it is a Game-Key Card, so the cartridge only unlocks the download and you need an internet connection to install it. If you mainly want a box for your shelf that is fine; if you want to play offline without downloading, buy a game with the full data on the cartridge instead. It supports nine languages, including Spanish.
